verdict.rationale: GST is a government tax-filing system and portal for registration, returns, payments, ITC, refunds, notices and appeals, not a platform that hosts user-built automations. Versioning, reviewing and rolling back automations is therefore a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows GST ships any automation-authoring, versioning or rollback capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
